summary: Iteration 3 regression on hardened prod (marketplace-hardened.preview.emergentagent.com). 36/36 backend regression tests pass, including public smoke, leads idempotency, chatbot LLM+finalize, freelancer register (under_review), JWT auth + /me, admin auth-gate on 4 GET endpoints + pipeline/run, brute-force rate-limit 429, SEO (sitemap.xml/sitemap-core.xml/robots.txt), security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy), and backend docs disabled (/api/docs, /api/openapi.json, /api/redoc all 404). Frontend: home hero 'Your next idea, expertly built.' renders, header Admin link opens /admin login page, admin login with provided creds succeeds (token persisted in localStorage key erf_admin_token, dashboard shows Leads/WhatsApp Alerts/Pipeline/Freelancers/Facts/Exports/Search Console tabs, Sign out visible). 'Post a Requirement' modal submits successfully (Project Brief Saved, Lead Record ID returned). Chatbot widget returns real Gemini/Emergent LLM reply for a bakery-ecommerce prompt. No blocking issues found.

issues: React 'unique key prop' warning from WorldwideMap render.
Hydration warning: <span> child of <option> from Emergent overlay instrumentation (noisy, non-blocking).

Rate-limit 429 on /api/auth/login is shown to admin user as generic 'Login failed. Please check your credentials.' — consider surfacing a specific rate-limit message so a legitimate admin does not think their password is wrong.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: Distinguish 429 from 401 on the admin login screen (specific message + retry-after hint).
OPTIONAL: Fix duplicate-key warning in WorldwideMap and hydration <span>/<option> warning to clean up console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS + security headers + generic 500 handler + JWT admin gate all working end-to-end on prod URL.
Rate-limit 429 is observable after ~10 rapid /api/auth/login attempts (slowapi decorator active).
Leads idempotency (POST /api/leads with same idempotencyKey -> 200 isDuplicate=true) works.
Chatbot end-to-end (Gemini via Emergent LLM key) returns rich, contextual replies for INR-budget bakery ecommerce prompt.
Backend FastAPI docs are properly disabled behind the /api prefix (404 on /api/docs, /api/openapi.json, /api/redoc).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_erfreelancer_api.py (updated BASE_URL + admin creds to current env)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (home, admin login+dashboard, enquiry modal, chatbot)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Iter3_* lead via POST /api/leads (idempotency verified), TEST_Iter3_Reg_* freelancer via /api/freelancers/register (under_review), TEST_ChatIter3 lead via /api/chat/finalize, and one UI-submitted lead TEST_UITest_Iter3 (lead-1789980510928-ppc2yc).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hardening iteration passes end-to-end. Note that the rate-limit is per-IP and shared between backend tests and browser sessions; if you burst /api/auth/login you must wait ~60s before UI admin login will succeed. Console has known noisy warnings (WorldwideMap keys, span-in-option hydration) that are non-blocking. Admin creds and JWT key/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY are configured; no changes to env needed.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. The prior iteration_2 concerns (cookie-based auth, CORS origin mismatch, bruteforce lockout 429) are now resolved on the hardened build: login rate-limit returns 429 correctly on the current preview origin, and CORS is locked to the frontend domain. The lockout state after 5 wrong attempts is not separately asserted here (429 from slowapi throttles first).
